slides.title: Parsing HTML
slides.content:
# Soup for the Soul 🍜

Beautiful Soup parses HTML (and XML) documents and creates a parse tree for traversing the pages.

```python
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests

html = requests.get('https://example.com').text
soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

print(soup.title.string) # 'Example Domain'
```

slides.title: Finding Elements
slides.content:
# Search Methods 🔎

## `find()`
Returns the **first** match.
```python
h1 = soup.find('h1')
```

## `find_all()`
Returns a **list** of all matches.
```python
links = soup.find_all('a')
for link in links:
    print(link['href']) # Get attribute
```

slides.title: CSS Selectors
slides.content:
# Only One Select 🎯

Use `select()` to find elements using CSS selectors (like jQuery or `querySelector`).

- Class: `.classname`
- ID: `#idname`
- Nested: `div p span`

```python
# Find all links inside footer div
items = soup.select("div.footer a")
```
